mapper.select: SELECT id, event_no AS eventNo, tunnel_id AS tunnelId, point_id AS pointId, hazard_type AS hazardType, item_type AS itemType, warn_level AS warnLevel, warn_status AS warnStatus, gate_stage AS gateStage, trigger_time AS triggerTime FROM warn_event WHERE point_id = #{pointId} AND warn_status IN (1, 2, 3, 4) ORDER BY trigger_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warn_event (event_no, tunnel_id, point_id, hazard_type, item_type, warn_level, warn_title, warn_content, warn_status, gate_stage, trigger_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{eventNo}, #{tunnelId}, #{pointId}, #{hazardType}, #{itemType}, #{warnLevel}, #{warnTitle}, #{warnContent}, #{warnStatus}, #{gateStage}, #{triggerTime}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE warn_event SET warn_status = #{warnStatus}, confirm_user_id = #{confirmUserId}, confirm_result = #{confirmResult}, confirm_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND warn_status = 1
UPDATE warn_event SET warn_status = 5, close_user_id = #{closeUserId}, close_reason = #{closeReason}, close_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND warn_status = 4
UPDATE warn_event SET warn_level = #{newLevel}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND warn_level < #{newLevel} AND warn_status IN (1, 2, 3)
UPDATE warn_event SET warn_level = #{newLevel}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND warn_level > #{newLevel} AND warn_status IN (1, 2, 3)
UPDATE warn_event SET warn_status = 3, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND warn_status IN (2, 3)
UPDATE warn_event SET warn_status = 4, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND warn_status = 3
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_no AS eventNo, tunnel_id AS tunnelId, point_id AS pointId, hazard_type AS hazardType, item_type AS itemType, warn_level AS warnLevel, warn_status AS warnStatus, gate_stage AS gateStage, trigger_time AS triggerTime, trigger_value AS triggerValue, hazard_event_id AS hazardEventId FROM warn_event WHERE id = #{id}

sql.if: AND (event_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR warn_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
